newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elite French officer killed in shootout.
newsitem.headline: Elite French officer killed in shootout.

text.p: A member of an elite French paramilitary police unit was killed during a shootout with a mentally disturbed individual in southeastern France on Monday, police said.
The unidentified member of the GIGN anti-terrorism unit was the first of the elite force to be killed in service since its creation, police officials said.

The officer was shot dead as police launched an assault on the deranged man's home, where he had been holed up since Saturday, the police said. The shootout took place in the town of Valaurie in the Drome region.
The disturbed man was later seized by police and taken to a nearby psychiatric hospital, police said.
